label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: A link whose only name is Panel and an icon, so its purpose is unclear when tabbing; this icon link appears first in the header on every page

findings.page: [name] de sonido y altavoces Wi-Fi para tu casa
findings.problem: About 20 Tab presses of header, promo bar and menu repeat on every page before reaching the first product, with no way to jump to the product list

findings.page: [name] de sonido y altavoces Wi-Fi para tu casa
findings.problem: Every product card starts with a button just called [name] that does not say which product it belongs to
Image carousel buttons are labelled in [name] (Previous slide, Next slide) on a [name] page, and an unnamed div takes keyboard focus right after them
[name] choice is announced twice, as a [name] Beam Ultra button and again as a Negro radio, which is confusing
After [name] al carrito nothing was announced and focus dropped to the top of the page; I only learned the item was added by tabbing back about 10 stops to the cart link that said 1 item
After opening the cart and after pressing [name] compra the page was blank for a moment with no loading message, and focus was left at the top

Cart page has six upsell [name] al carrito buttons plus embedded PayPal and Klarna pay buttons before the normal checkout link; going forward needs many Tab presses and the PayPal part is an unnamed div
Shipping form country list contains only [name] countries, so a United States address cannot be entered; the form also has about 8 more fields before the pay step, which did not fit in my step budget
